findings.title: Malformed interpolated string prevents compilation
findings.body: The assignment `typeName = "$"typeName_{Guid.NewGuid().ToString().Substring(0, 4)}";` is invalid C# syntax. The project cannot build, so AC-02 is not satisfied. This should use valid interpolation, such as `$"{typeName}_{Guid.NewGuid().ToString().Substring(0, 4)}"`.

findings.title: Foundation type name is not interpolated
findings.body: The string `"Foundation_{Math.Round(data.Length * 304.8)}_{Math.Round(data.Width * 304.8)}"` lacks the `$` prefix, so every initial duplicate uses the same literal name. After the syntax error below is fixed, different sizes will receive random suffixes and subsequent executions will fail to find and reuse those size-specific types, causing unnecessary duplicate family types.

findings.title: Degenerate first segment aborts the entire CAD import
findings.body: The main edge loop skips zero-length segments, but the closure check unconditionally normalizes `pts[1] - pts[0]`. A closed CAD polyline containing a repeated initial vertex therefore throws during `Normalize()`, and the exception propagates out of extraction, preventing all otherwise valid foundations from being placed. The closure direction should be derived from the first non-zero edge, and malformed outlines should be skipped without aborting the complete import.
